summary: Reconstructs the per-point LiDAR beam direction (unit vector from aircraft toward ground) from scan-angle + PSID metadata. Per flight strip (PSID), runs PCA on iso-angle bands + swath edges over the building points to recover the flight heading, derives the perpendicular cross-track axis, sign-aligns it against scan-angle ordering, then optionally refines the model with a multi-return along-track correction estimated from return-1 -> return-2 pairs. v3 keeps only the load-bearing output (beam-directions, F32x3 per global point) that v7-boundary-signals' nearby-projection consumes; all viz outputs and the sun-beam pipeline are dropped.

phases.name: Group building points by PSID
phases.description: Walks the flattened building-indices list, looks up each point's PSID and appends the global index into a per-strip member list. Strip order is first-seen (replicates v2's Map iteration order).

phases.name: Per-strip flight-direction PCA
phases.description: For each strip with at least minPointsPerStrip members, sorts members by scan angle then runs 2x2 horizontal-plane PCA on 7 iso-angle bands plus the low and high swath-edge slices (top 3% by angle, min 20 members each). Each band that exceeds minBandElongation contributes its dominant eigenvector to an accumulator with sign-alignment against the running average. Result: a unit flight heading per strip; cross-track is the +90 deg perpendicular, then sign-flipped so that above-median-scan-angle points project further along it than below-median ones.

phases.name: Multi-return along-track correction
phases.description: Walks consecutive (gi, gi+1) pairs where both share PSID and number-of-returns, are return 1 then return 2 respectively, and have scan-angle jitter <= mrMaxAngleJitter. The 3D vector p2-p1 IS the true beam direction. Subtracting the scan-angle model's horizontal beam (sin(alpha)*cross-track) gives a per-pair horizontal residual; averaged per strip when at least mrMinPairs survive, the mean residual becomes the strip's along-track correction (dx, dz). On dahouet this captures the ~7 deg along-track scanner tilt that the cross-track-only scan-angle model misses entirely (see journal 2026-04-02-beam-direction-multireturn).

phases.name: Per-point beam-direction array
phases.description: Pre-fills the output (n_pts x 3) with the default straight-down vector along the up-axis. For each strip with a fit, computes per-member beam = normalize(sin(alpha)*ct + corr, -cos(alpha)) and writes it into the output slot for that strip-member's global index. Points outside any building / outside any fitted strip keep the default down-vector.

parameters.name: minPointsPerStrip
parameters.summary: Minimum building points in a strip before Phase 2a will attempt a fit.
parameters.rationale: Tiny strips give noisy PCA bands; below ~30 building points the iso-angle bands fall under the 10-member band-floor and the fit collapses.

parameters.name: minBandElongation
parameters.summary: Eigenvalue ratio e1/e2 a PCA band must exceed to count as a clear line in Phase 2a.
parameters.rationale: Swath-edge / iso-angle bands should form a near-linear arrangement along the flight axis. Below 3:1 elongation the band is a blob, not a line, and its eigenvector is unreliable.

parameters.name: mrMinPairs
parameters.summary: Minimum surviving return-1 -> return-2 pairs in a strip before Phase 2b commits a correction.
parameters.rationale: With fewer than ~5 pairs the mean residual is dominated by surface-geometry noise rather than the systematic along-track tilt the correction is meant to capture.

parameters.name: mrMaxAngleJitter
parameters.summary: Max scan-angle delta between consecutive returns to count as a same-beam pair (Phase 2b).
parameters.rationale: Returns from the same emitted pulse share a scan angle to encoder precision; a 0.1 deg gate rejects pairs that are merely adjacent in storage order but came from different beams.

parameters.name: mrMinPairDist
parameters.summary: Minimum 3D separation between return 1 and return 2 to use the pair (Phase 2b).
parameters.rationale: Coincident returns give a zero-length direction; the 5 cm floor rejects degenerate / quantization-noise pairs.

parameters.name: upAxis
parameters.summary: Which of (0=x, 1=y, 2=z) is the vertical axis. v3 wrapper forces 2 (z-up) for production LAZ; the impl default is 1 (y-up) for the v2 bench frame.
parameters.rationale: v2 ran in a y-up bench coordinate frame; v3 production reads Lambert93 LAZ in its native z-up. The horizontal-plane PCA, cross-track perpendicular, and 'straight-down' default all need to know which axis is vertical; the wrapper hardcodes 2 (see v7-beam-incidence.c:62) to match the v3 loader.

reads.name: per-building-records
reads.description: Per-building records — read only to harvest each building's globalIndices block, which is concatenated into a flat tile-wide 'building points' list for the per-strip PCA. The step never iterates per-building inside the impl.

reads.name: scan-angles
reads.description: Tile-wide F32 scan angle in degrees from nadir (per-point LAZ metadata).

reads.name: point-source-ids
reads.description: Tile-wide U16 PointSourceID — flight-strip identifier used to partition points before per-strip PCA.

reads.name: return-numbers
reads.description: Tile-wide U8 return number (1, 2, ...). Optional; absence disables Phase 2b multi-return correction (same behaviour as v2).

reads.name: number-of-returns
reads.description: Tile-wide U8 number-of-returns per pulse. Optional; paired with return-numbers.

writes.name: bi-directions
writes.description: Tile-wide F32x3 unit beam direction per global point, pointing from aircraft toward the ground. Strip-fit points get the modeled beam (with multi-return correction if available); all other points get the default straight-down vector along the up-axis. Note: artifact name is 'bi-directions' (v3 shortened name); v2 emitted the same column as 'beam-directions'.

v3_divergences.rationale: v2 emitted four artifacts: beam-incidence (1 m edges), beam-directions, beam-psid-colors (RGB per point), beam-incidence-meta (per-strip diagnostics). Only beam-directions is on the V7 DAG (consumed by boundary-signals' nearby-projection). v3 keeps just that one output.

v2 Phase 5 computed solar position from GPS time + Lambert93->lat/lon and emitted yellow sun-beam edges. Pure viz; would need lidar-metadata + lambert93-origin reads that v3 doesn't surface on this path. Dropped wholesale (per the Phase 5.6 audit).
Standard v7 step-prefix convention in v3 (bi = beam-incidence). Consumers in v7-boundary-signals read 'bi-directions'.

v3_divergences.topic: Compute scope vs storage scope made explicit
v3_divergences.rationale: v3 documents the recurring pattern (this step is held up as the cleanest example): compute runs only on building points (per-building-records globalIndices, flattened) because the per-strip PCA wants planar surfaces — but storage is tile-wide F32x3xN so downstream consumers can index by any global gi. Non-building slots keep the default straight-down vector.

v3_divergences.topic: minR2 parameter exposed in v2 meta but unused in v5
v3_divergences.rationale: v2 meta.params still lists minR2 (default 0.1), a leftover from the original v1/v2 gradient-fit algorithm. v5 replaced the gradient fit with PCA-on-bands (minBandElongation) in commit 173fcbd; the minR2 param is dead in v2 and not surfaced in v3.

v3_divergences.topic: PCA up_axis abstraction (impl default y-up, wrapper forces z-up)
v3_divergences.rationale: v2 hardcoded the horizontal plane as (x, z) — i.e., y-up. v3's impl is parameterised over up_axis so the same code runs under the bench harness (y-up, byte-identity test) and under production v3 (z-up LAZ). v7-beam-incidence.c:62 sets up_axis=2 unconditionally; the v2-comparison bench wrapper overrides to 1.

related.summary: Survey of 5 candidate methods for recovering flight heading from per-point metadata; documents the Riegl VQ-780 II scan geometry assumptions baked into the model and the y-up/z-up coordinate-system pitfalls. The PCA-on-bands method is what landed in Phase 2a.

Root-cause of the 'nearby ground points project inside the roof instead of at the eave' bug: the scan-angle model is purely cross-track and misses the ~7 deg along-track scanner / pitch tilt. Multi-return ret1->ret2 pairs measure the true beam directly; their mean horizontal residual vs the model becomes Phase 2b's per-strip correction (+0.128 P15, -0.131 P16 on dahouet).
Synthetic flight-strip generator + harmonized per-point metadata schema (PSID, scan angle, return numbers) that beam-incidence consumes.
Deep dive on PointSourceID semantics in IGN LiDAR HD — informs the per-strip grouping in Phase 1.
v2: initial WIP — scan-angle gradient fit, 1 m beam edges, sun-position pipeline. (meta.version=1).
v2: beam incidence + sun position + plane slugs + .bin v2 Float32 scan angles. Sets up the metadata surface.
v2: bumps meta.version 2 -> 5 — replaces gradient fit with PCA on swath edges + iso-angle bands; adds Phase 2b multi-return correction; adds the beam-directions output the v3 port keeps.
v2: restored 1 m edge length default (reverted a debug 10 m bump from 173fcbd).

v3 Phase 5.6: port v7-beam-incidence. Byte-identical to v2 dump on dahouet (137088/137088 floats match exactly, no F64 noise on first try). Drops Phases 4 + 5 + viz outputs; keeps Phases 1, 2a, 2b, 3b -> single bi-directions output.

related.section: Phase 5.6 + 'boundary-signals vertical-beam fallback must be removed'
related.summary: Port-level documentation. Also documents the post-port finding that v2's vertical-beam fallback in boundary-signals (when bi-directions is absent) is wrong-and-unusable; v3 should make bi-directions strictly required.

open_questions: Should v7-boundary-signals refuse to run when bi-directions is absent, instead of falling back to (0, -1, 0)? PHASE-5-V7-PORT.md flags v2's vertical-beam fallback as 'wrong and unusable' but v3 has not yet enforced the strict-required contract.
